events.body: ## Context `scripts/readme/update_readme.py` `describe()` strips `*`, `_` and backticks, which turns blt-cron's `` `* * * * *` `` into "( )" in the root README's BLT-Cron row. `blog_section()` emits `` without `alt`. `scripts/readme/` has no tests. ## What to do 1. In `describe`, convert inline code spans to text before stripping emphasis. 2. Add `alt` (escaped title) in `blog_section`. 3. Add `scripts/readme/test_update_readme.py` for `describe`, `replace_section`, and `is_bot`/`slugify` from contributors.py; extend the `scripts` row in tests.tsv with `python3 -m unittest discover -s readme -p 'test_*.py'`. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] Regenerated README shows "(* * * * *)" in the cron row - [ ] Blog images have alt text - [ ] `scripts/ci/test.sh scripts` passes ## How to test locally ```bash scripts/ci/test.sh scripts python3 scripts/readme/update_readme.py --offline && git diff README.md ``` --- Size: **S**. Comment `/assign` to claim this issue; claims with no activity are released after 7 days. Clone from https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT.git and open your pull request there.
events.title: scripts: keep inline code in README project descriptions and add tests for scripts/readme
